title: Owner: leave the macOS lavender-into-subtitle overlap for the device check
context: At a 1140x724 macOS window, the tall lavender bloom on the onboarding Mood step reaches into the subtitle (Lane 5 render mac-08). The app copies the prototype's macOS scene geometry. I could not confirm the prototype's behaviour at that size because it did not respond in the preview pane.
options: Leave it for the owner's Mac check
Scale the scene on short windows
outcome: The owner chose to leave it for the device check. No code change; it joins the owner's Mac checklist.
